title: StitchVector 3.0 minimal line recovery: colour check at crossings + logical_id on top of the unchanged 2.0 detector. Pushed and remote-verified before the new test seeds are generated.
questions: Are visually complete but fragmented lines selectable as one logical object after adding logical_id only (no geometry change)?
Does a colour check on the 2.0 straight-through join remove real cross-line objects without hurting the drawing?
Which severe miss (pale, width-varying, touching a same-colour fill) is cheapest to improve? (diagnosis only)

methods.2.0+id: 2.0 objects + logical_id from the frozen linker sv_linker (58cd05b); geometry unchanged
methods.3.0: sv_v3.extract_v3 = 2.0 with one extra condition: a straight-through join at a skeleton junction also needs chain colour dE <= join_col_dE; the drawn chains are exactly those 2.0 draws; then logical_id from the frozen linker. join_col_dE = inf reproduces 2.0 (unit-tested).

dev_disclosure: Tried on dev seeds 1001-1003 and on the already-viewed P1 test seeds 2001-2005 before freeze: (a) splitting all output at skeleton junctions into edges: dropped or added ink vs 2.0 (up to 1,150 px removed when short groups were dropped, false length up to 0.126 when kept), rejected; (b) colour check with join_col_dE 20/30/35/40/inf on dev, 35 chosen (fewest cross-line objects on dev without the select count rising above 2.0+id by more than ~0.3); (c) the mixed-object metric was corrected after viewing images (sv_v3_eval: only length near ONE line counts, outside the zone where two lines are both within 2 px). Under the corrected metric the P1 test seeds have 1 real cross-line object in 2.0 (seed 2002), not 13 as in line_recovery_review.md section 1.6; the 12 others run along a shallow crossing. Results of these trials are committed as v3/v3_dev.json and v3/v3_viewed_p1test.json. Test seeds 4001-4005 were never generated before freeze.

per_line: recall: share of 1 px truth samples within 2 px of any object
recall_own: same using only the logical objects that belong to this line (>= 60% of their length within 2 px)
select_count: logical objects belonging to the line = objects a user picks to select the whole line
mixed_objects_on_line: logical objects running >= 10 px along this AND another line outside their shared zone
metrics.verdict: cross_line_error if any mixed object; acceptable if recall_own >= 0.9 and select_count <= 2; found_needs_grouping if recall_own >= 0.9; else visual_miss
global: logical objects, geometry parts, mixed objects, false length share (detected length > 3 px from every truth line)

images: original / 2.0 objects / 3.0 logical objects (one colour per logical_id) / 3.0 on original, per test tile, plus up to 5 zoomed grouping examples; local only (pre-push hook blocks PNG)
stop_rule: one run on test seeds, <= 10 min CPU; no code or parameter change after the first number
not_done: changes to POC-01 / D71 / Oracle / P1 / Line Recovery records
